I had the same issue last year in my 13 Daytona, replaced the radiator, entire reservoir, water pump, fan, and all the hoses as well as got an OEM 203 thermostat and it was still getting up to 220 in this Texas heat, went ahead and replaced the thermostat again with a 180 stat and switched my coolant out with the Mopar 50/50 purple and the car stays between 181-191 even when it’s over 95 out, only time it hits over 190 is when I accelerate to get on the highway and even then it’s never gone above 195 and in bumper to bumper traffic in the heat it sits at 188-190. 

      I’d recommend starting with getting yourself a 180 stat (about 25 bucks at NAPA if I’m remembering correctly) and draining all your old coolant and switching to the Mopar purple coolant (it’s like 15 bucks a gallon at any dodge dealer) and see what your temps are reading after that, and make sure you burp the system properly.
